rome-abruzzo-gran-sasso-high-road.slogan: A 263 km loop out of L’Aquila
rome-abruzzo-gran-sasso-high-road.story: Big empty plateau roads above Rome. A 263 km loop that starts and ends near L'Aquila, about 5 h 03 of riding. It goes by way of Gran Sasso view road and Santo Stefano di Sessanio. Campo Imperatore is the high point. It tops out at about 1,300 m. It is a high-mountain day.
